task_description: Write a method in Dafny to sum the length of the names of a given list of names after removing the names that start with a lowercase letter.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method SumLengthsOfNames(names: seq<string>) returns (totalLength: nat)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - totalLength is the sum of the lengths of names in the input list that do not start with a lowercase letter
- Only names that do not start with a lowercase letter are included in the sum
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method SumLengthsOfNames(names: seq<string>) returns (totalLength: int)

Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The input is a sequence of strings (names), which can be empty or non-empty

Dafny specification:
    requires names != null

Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The total length is the sum of lengths of all names that do not start with a lowercase letter

Dafny specification:
    ensures totalLength == sum of lengths of all names in names where name[0] is not a lowercase letter

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method SumLengthsOfNames(names: seq<string>) returns (totalLength: int)
    requires names != null
    ensures totalLength == sum i | 0 <= i < |names| :: if names[i][0] !in 'a'..'z' then |names[i]| else 0
{
    totalLength := 0;
    var i := 0;
    while i < |names|
        invariant 0 <= i <= |names|
        invariant totalLength == sum j | 0 <= j < i :: if names[j][0] !in 'a'..'z' then |names[j]| else 0
    {
        if |names[i]| > 0 && names[i][0] !in 'a'..'z' {
            totalLength := totalLength + |names[i]|;
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
